federation.title: Mokgatlo wa Federation
federation.subtitle: Di-pubkey tše di tshepšago, lesebo leo le saennwego, di-DM tša sefapano-node.
federation.intro: Federation lumella basebedisi ba ka node A molaetsa basebedisi ba ka node B. Ke kgetha-ka ka opareitara e. Di-pubkey tša node di tshepša ka go lebanya; ga go na mokgwa wa go itiriša wa "node efe goba efe e ka kopanya le ya ka".
federation.h1p1: Node e nngwe le e nngwe e boloka `federations (pubkey, ntlha ya mafelelo, health_score, added_at, added_by)`.
federation.h1p2: Go oketša thaka go nyaka kgato ya molaodi yeo e saennwego ke opareitara. Admin UI e bontšha kgatišo ya menwana ya remoutu gore bao ba šomago ka yona ba kgone go netefatša ka ntle ga sehlopha.
federation.h1p3: Dithaka tše di tlošitšwego di dula di le ka go DB tše di swailwego `revoked_at` bakeng sa tlhahlobo. Dikgopelo tše mpsha tša kopano go tšwa go pubkey ye e swanago di a ganwa go fihlela molaodi a un-revokes.
federation.h2p1: Outbound go tšwa go A go ya go user@B: node A e phuthela enfelopo ya molaetša ka blob ye e saennwego gomme e POSTs `/federation/deliver` go node B.
federation.h2p2: Enfelopo: `{mohlodi_node, sepheo_mosebedisi, ka hare_ciphertext, ka hare_nonce, rometsoeng_ka, sig}`. Sig e akaretša se sengwe le se sengwe ntle le sig ka boyona.
federation.h2p3: Node B e netefatša mosaeno kgahlanong le `source_node` pubkey go tšwa tafoleng ya yona ya `federations`. Sig e sa šomego → 401 + tiragalo ya go hlahloba.
federation.h3p1: Ge e ba B ga e fihlelelege, A e methaladi ka go `federation_outbox (target_node, payload, maiteko, next_retry_at)`.
federation.h3p2: Exponential backoff: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, e khupeditšwe ka 6h. Go palelwa ga sa ruri ka morago ga matšatši a 14.
federation.h3p3: Operator temoso mollo ha outbox botebo > 1000 melaetsa - bontša e khomaretse federation kgokagano.
federation.h4p1: E nngwe le e nngwe ya 60 s node ye nngwe le ye nngwe e ping `GET /v1/health` go thaka ye nngwe le ye nngwe. Nako ya karabelo + boemo bo latišišitšwe.
federation.h4p2: Maduo a maphelo: mathomo a 100. Nako ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya go fela e tloša 1; katlego e nngwe le e nngwe e tlaleletša ka 1 (cap 100). Score 0 → federation e ile ya ema bakeng sa thaka yeo.
federation.h4p3: E phatlaladitšwe ka `GET /v1/dithaka` bakeng sa di-dashboard tša opareitara.
federation.h1_a: Federation ka Vortex ke kamano ya go tshepana magareng ga bao ba šomago ka node ba babedi. Node e nngwe le e nngwe e phatlalatša senotlelo sa setšhaba sa Ed25519 sa di-byte tše 32; node e nngwe e e tlaleletša tafoleng ya `trusted_nodes` go bapa le ntlha ya yona ya mafelelo le maemo a maphelo.
federation.h1_b: Go oketša pubkey ye e tshepagalago go nyaka gore opareitara a saene kgopelo ya admin ka senotlelo sa go lokollwa sa node ka noši. UI e bontšha kgatišo ya menwana ya remoutu ka mokgwa wa 64-hex-char gore balaodi ba kgone go netefatša ka ntle ga sehlopha. Hang ha eketswa, mong le e mong kenang federation enfelopo e netefatsoa khahlanong le hore pubkey o Ed25519 mosaeno - forgeries ba lemohuoa hang-hang le logged. Go phumola go boleta: mothaladi o dula o swailwe `revoked_at` bakeng sa tlhahlobo, eupša mosaeno wa enfelopo bjale o a palelwa.
federation.h1_c: Paterone e tšwa go kopano ya Matrix (moo seva ye nngwe le ye nngwe e bapatšago senotlelo sa go saena gomme tiragalo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e saennwe ka yona) le go tšwa go DKIM ya imeile (moo DNS e phatlalatšago senotlelo sa go saena). Matrix pakile mohlala o sebetsa ka tekanyo - marangrang bona na ka fetang 100k federated di-server. Vortex ya fapaneng fapana ka ho hloka ka ho hlaka bobeli kgetha-in ho e-na le Matrix o "seva efe kapa efe ka federate ka default" molao; re ile ra ananya boiketlo bakeng sa tšhireletšo e matla kgahlanong le kopano ya bofora.
federation.h1_f:
mothaladi wa di-node_tše di tshepšago:
  senotlelo sa go nwa : 32 di-byte Ed25519
  ntlha ya mafelelo : https://...
  maemo_a_bophelo : int [0, 100].
  e okeditšwe_ka : unix_ms
  e okeditšwe_ka : admin_modiriši_id
  e phumotšwe_ka : unix_ms | NULL .
federation.h2_a: Molaetša wa sefapano sa noutu o namela enfelopo ye e swanago ya E2E le ya selegae, e phuthetšwe ka enfelopo ya ka ntle ye e saennwego yeo e netefatšago noutu ye e romelago go noutu ye e amogelago.
federation.h2_b: Node A e nyaka go iša go user@B. Mohato 1: A serialises ` {mohloli_node, sepheo_mosebedisi, ka hare_ciphertext, ka hare_nonce, rometsoeng_ka}`. Mohato 2: A saena di-byte serialized le senotlolo sa yona sa poraefete sa Ed25519 → `sig`. Mohato 3: A POSTs tuple ho `POST /federation/deliver` ka node B. Mohato 4: B sheba `source_node` ka `trusted_nodes` lona, ​​netefatsa `sig`, hlahloba `sent_at` khahlanong le replay-fensetere, 'me phehella enfelopo ka hare ka `messages` tafoleng lona sebakeng seo. Moreki wa moamogedi o e bona gabotse bjalo ka molaetša wa selegae — legato la kopano ga le bonagale go badiriši ba mafelelo.
federation.h2_c: Enfelopo ye e saennwego ya ka ntle e adimilwe go tšwa ditiragalong tša kopano tša `m.room.message` tša Matrix. Lefasetere la go bapala gape (metsotso ye 5) le tlhokego ya gore ditempe tša nako tše di saennwego ke mothopo di sepelelane le tšhupamabaka ya lebota di adimilwe go tšwa go DKIM. Mathomong Vortex (v0.0.2) o ile a leka kopanyo e sa saennweng le TLS bareki certs; re fetogile go payload signatures ka v0.0.5 ka morago ga go lemoga moreki certs ga ba phologe mojaro balancers le pata netefatšo ya nnete go tšwa go legato la tirišo.
federation.h2_f:
enfelopo = { .
  mohlodi_node : hex32, .
  sepheo_mosebedisi : int64, .
  sengwalwa_sa_cipher_ka gare: dibaete, .
  ka gare_nonce : dibaete, .
  rometšwe_ka : unix_ms, .
} .
sig = Ed25519Sign (mohloli_priv, CBOR (enfelopo))
POST /federation/go tliša { enfelopo, saena } .
federation.h3_a: Ge node ya kgole e sa fihlelelege, node ye e romelago e bea enfelopo ka methaladi ka gare ga `federation_outbox` ya yona gomme e leka gape ka go boela morago ga exponential.
federation.h3_b: Backoff kemiso: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, capped ka 6h. Ka maiteko a mangwe le a mangwe a paletšwego kholomo ya mothaladi ya `maiteko` e a oketšega gomme `next_retry_at` e beakantšwe go bjale + kgato ya bjale. Mošomi wa ka morago (`app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) o tsoga s e nngwe le e nngwe e 5 gomme o topa mela moo `next_retry_at <= bjale ()`. Katlego e phumola mola; Matšatši a 14 a go palelwa a e swaya sa ruri gomme o romele temošo ya admin.
federation.h3_c: Exponential backoff le siling ke mohlala o tšoanang Kafka o sebelisa bakeng sa motšweletši retries le SMTP sebelisa bakeng sa bounced poso. Kepisi ya matšatši a 14 e swana le kgothaletšo ya SMTP 5321. Diphetolelo tša mathomo di šomišitše diteko tše di sa fetogego tša metsotswana ye 60 tšeo di hlotšego di-spike tša mohlape wa go duma ge thaka e boa inthaneteng ka morago ga go kgaotša; exponential phatlalala lokisa hore ka v0.0.7.
federation.h3_f:
tiego (n) = min (6h, 1s · 2 ) bakeng sa n = 0, 1, 2, ...

lenaneo la go leka gape: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, ..., 6h
temošo: outbox_depth > 1000 bakeng sa > 5 mets
federation.h4_a: Metsotswana e mengwe le e mengwe e 60 node e nngwe le e nngwe e ping ntlha ya mafelelo ya thaka e nngwe le e nngwe ya `/v1/health`. Dintlha di tšhabela godimo ge di atlega, di theogela fase ge di palelwa, di lekanyeditšwe ka [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Score e thoma ka 100 ka go tlaleletša. Katlego ye nngwe le ye nngwe e tlaleletša +1 (e khupeditšwe ka 100), nako ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya go fela e tloša -1 (e filwe ka 0). Score 0 pauses federation ho thaka eo — melaetsa e mecha mola ka outbox, ha ho na e ncha outbound pelehi maiteko ho fihlela lintlha namela morao ka holimo ho 20. The lintlha e pepentšhwa ka `GET /v1 / dithaka` bakeng sa opareitara e dashboards le ka ` / metrics` bakeng sa Prometheus. Go theoga ga maemo a tšhoganetšo go ralala le dithaka tše ntši ka lefasetereng le le kopana go hlohleletša temošo ya "go belaelwa karoganyo ya netweke".
federation.h4_c: Dintlha tša setaele sa AIMD di hlohleleditšwe ke lefasetere la pitlagano la TCP le damper ya go hlahloba maphelo ya Akamai. The asymmetric ± 1 mohato (ho e-na le TCP halving) etsa hore ho hlaphoheloa butle ho feta ho hloleha, e leng biases tsamaiso ea nģ'a hlokolosi - re 'na rather pause federation ha u sa kholiseha ho feta romela melaetsa pheta-pheta ka flapping kgokelo. E okeditšwe ka go v0.0.6 ka morago ga gore thaka yeo e sa itshwarego gabotse e khutše dithaka tše pedi tše botse ka go leka gape.
federation.h4_f:
ka katlego: lintlha = min (100, lintlha + 1)
ka nako ya go fela: lintlha = max (0, lintlha - 1)
ge e ba maemo == 0: khutša_federation (thaka) .
ge e ba maemo >= 20: thoma_federation (dithaka) // hysteresis

gossip.title: Gossip le go utolla dithaka
gossip.subtitle: Kamoo di-node di hwetšago e nngwe le e nngwe ntle le registry ya bogareng.
gossip.intro: Ka ntle ga lenaneo leo le hlatsetšwego la molaodi, di-node tša Vortex di seba dithaka gare ga tšona. Se se utolla di-node tše mpsha ge bao ba šomago ba di dikološa, le ge molaodi a se a di hlatsela go fihla ga bjale.
gossip.h1p1: E mong le e 60 s, node kgetha thaka tšohanyetso le romela 256-bit Bloom filtara ya dithaka tsejoang. Dithaka di araba ka dithaka NOT ka gare ga sefa, gotee le sefa ya yona. Bandwidth ke ` O (dithaka tse ntjha × 32 bytes)`, ka go tlhaolega tlas'a 1 KiB ka potoloho.
gossip.h1p2: Thaka e nngwe le e nngwe yeo e bapaditšwego e saennwe ke noutu ya papatšo. Bareki netefatša ditshaeno ka kgokagano ya mathomo - mohlaselwa a ka se forge thaka ka gare ga lesebo.
gossip.h1p3: The potoloho ke sekhahla-lekanyelitsoeng: phapanyetsano e le 'ngoe ka thaka ka 30 s (sliding fensetere).
gossip.h2p1: New nodes qala ka 8 hardcoded bootstrap balaoli. Pele lesebo potoloho utolla masome a dithaka; netweke le converges ka ~ 1 motsotso.
gossip.h2p2: Lenaneo la bootstrap le ka rulaganywa ka `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=senotlolo1@ntlha ya mafelelo1,senotlelo sa2@ntlha ya mafelelo2,...`.
gossip.h3p1: Thaka ye nngwe le ye nngwe ye e bapaditšwego e swanetše go saenwa ke senotlelo sa go lokollwa sa Ed25519 sa opareitara. Go fora tsebišo ya dithaka go nyaka go utswa senotlelo se se šomago.
gossip.h3p2: Bohlatse-bja-mosebetsi (fetolehang, default 2 ^ 18 etellang pele mafela) ka ncha lithaka ngodiso boloka bongata Sybil-bot maqhubu a sa sebetseng.
gossip.h3p3: Tshepedišo ya botumo: dithaka tšeo di itshwarago gampe (ditshaeno tše mpe, ditsebišo tša bofora, go fela ga nako leboelela) di na le go bola ga botumo bja tšona. Lefela botumo → lenane le letsho.
gossip.h1_a: E nngwe le e nngwe ya 60 s node e nngwe le e nngwe e kgetha thaka ya go se kgethe gomme e romela sefa ya Bloom ya 256-bit yeo e akaretšago dithaka tše di tsebjago. Dithaka di araba ka dithaka tše mpsha + sefa ya yona. Bandwidth ke `O (dithaka_new × 32 di-byte)`.
gossip.h1_b: Bloom filtara k = 5 hashes, m = 256 dikotwana tse. Node A e tsenya di-peer_id tša yona ka moka tše di tsebjago. E romela go thaka ya B. B e botšiša sefa le ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya dithaka tša yona; selo se sengwe le se sengwe seo se fošago, B e romela go A (gotee le sefa ya yona). A o dira tshekatsheko ye e swanago ka go bušetša morago. Ka morago ga phapanyetsano di-node ka bobedi di abelana ka tsebo e ka bago e swanago. Phapanyetsano e tloaelehileng: 200-800 bytes. Diapdeite di kopana go ralala le netweke ka ~ 5 dipotologo (5 metsotso) ka lebaka la thepa ya lesebo.
gossip.h1_c: Lesebo la Bloom-filter le thomile go pampiri ya Cornell ya 1998 ya bimodal multicast. Apache Cassandra e e šomiša bakeng sa boleloko; Bitcoin bakeng sa kgwebišano relay; IPFS bakeng sa DHT tlhokomelo. Thepa ya kopanyo ya O (log N) ke yona e dirago gore e be yeo e swanetšego gabotse bakeng sa tšhomišo ya rena — ga re hloke dipono tša lefase ka bophara, e no ba mafelelong-tsebo ya dithaka yeo e sa fetogego. Filter boholo (256 dikotwana tse) e tuned kahoo maaka-positive sekhahla ke < 1 % ka 100 lithaka.
gossip.h2_a: New nodes qala ka 8 hardcoded bootstrap balaoli. Pele lesebo potoloho utolla ho feta; converges ka ~ 1 motsotso.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` e romela le `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS = senotlelo sa 1 @ ntlha ya mafelelo1, senotlelo sa 2 @ ntlha ya mafelelo 2, ...`. Ka go thoma, node e leka e nngwe le e nngwe ka tatelano. Pele go arabela e fana ka lenaneo la mathomo la dithaka (ka `GET /v1/trusted_nodes`). Node e tsenya tšeo tafoleng ya yona ya dithaka tša lefelong leo, e di swaya bjalo ka tšeo di bootstrapped, gomme e thoma 60 s gossip loop. Dipotologo tše di latelago di utolla dithaka tša dithaka.
gossip.h2_c: Hardcoded bootstraps ke mohlala o tšoanang Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS sebelisa. The e nngwe — DHT-thehiloeng kutollo — hloka pele ho kena leha ho le joalo. Vortex ya 8 bootstrap count e ile ya kgethwa ka gobane go ba le > 4 go fa go kgotlelela kgahlanong le ditiragalo tše 2-3 tša nako e tee ya go se šome, gomme < 16 e boloka faele ya `.env` e balega. Beakanya ka-go tsenywa tirišong ka go rulaganya `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS`.
gossip.h3_a: Thaka ye nngwe le ye nngwe ye e bapaditšwego e swanetše go saenwa ke senotlelo sa go lokolla sa Ed25519 sa modiriši wa yona wa setlogo. Mohlasedi a ka se kgone go hlama dithaka ka gare ga netweke.
gossip.h3_b: Ge node A e bapatša thaka P ka lesebo go node B, A e akaretša `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, le setempe sa nako, ka moka di saennwe ke senotlelo sa go lokollwa sa P ka noši. B o netefatša mosaeno pele a bota P. Ge e ba B ka morago a ikgokaganya le P le P’s TLS cert + first heartbeat ga e swane le pubkey yeo e bapaditšwego, papatšo e swaiwa e na le mpholo gomme e phatlalatšwa go ya fase.
gossip.h3_c: Dipapatšo tša dithaka tše di saennwego ke primitive ya maemo ya kgahlanong le Sybil go tšwa go Chord (2001) le Kademlia (2002). Bitcoin o addr melaetsa sebelisa e fokolang ea mohlala (ha ho na ditshaeno, itšetlehile ka kgokelo ditjeo e le Sybil thibelo); Ethereum ya discv5 matšoao. Vortex e amogetše dipapatšo tše di saennwego go v0.0.6 ka morago ga gore mohlaselwa wa testnet a bapatše dithaka tša bofora tše 1000 ka node e tee ye e lego molaong.
gossip.h1_f:
filtara: k = 5, m = 256 dikotwana tse
kenya (x) = bakeng sa ke ka 0..k: filtara [hash_ke (x) mod m] = 1
potšišo (x) = bakeng sa ke ka 0..k: hlahloba filtara [hash_i (x) mod m].
maaka-positive ka 100 dithaka, 256 dikotwana tse, k = 5: ~ 0.4 %
gossip.h2_f:
.env: 1 .
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd...@https://a.mohlala,efgh...@https://b.mohlala

go thoma: .
  bakeng sa thaka ka go BOOTSTRAP_PEERS:
    leka: dithaka ← thaka.get (' / v1 / tšepahalang_nodes '); kgaotša
    ntle le: tšwela pele
  thoma lesebo loop

stealth.title: Netweke ya go utswa
stealth.subtitle: Magato a mahlano, mekgwa e 28. Se sengwe le se sengwe go tloga go TLS padding go ya go ditirelo tša Tor onion.
stealth.intro: Vortex e tšea gore ke lenaba la maemo a mmušo wa setšhaba. Mokgobo wa go utswa o na le legato ka fao le ge dillaga tša ka ntle di tlogetšwe, tša ka gare di sa fa tirelo ye e senyegilego-eupša-e šomago.
stealth.h1: Ke ka baka la’ng dillaga tše hlano
stealth.h1p1: Llaga 1 - kgatiso ya menwana normalisation. Emisa dihlopha tša go se dire selo.
stealth.h1p2: Llaga 2 - sebopeho / boholo morphing. Emisa sephethephethe-tshekatsheko classifiers.
stealth.h1p3: Llaga 3 - prothokholo camouflage. E emisa mafolofolo DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Llaga 4 - pluggable dinamelwa. E šoma ka dinetweke tšeo di thibelago primary ya rena.
stealth.h1p5: Llaga 5 - ho qetela-mothata fallback. Eiee, BMP, multi-hop relay. E šoma ge go se na selo se sengwe seo se dirago.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello e swana le Chrome go Windows 11 baite-ka-baete. JA3/JA4 hash matches Chrome 120 - ha ho Vortex-itseng kgatiso ya menwana.
stealth.h2p2: Record-layer padding: direkoto tsohle TLS paded ho 16 KB. Bogolo bja dipakete bo swana le sephethephethe sa sephephediši sa bontši.
stealth.h2p3: Go romela ka seelo sa go se fetoge: mothaladi o ntšha foreime e tee N ms ye nngwe le ye nngwe go sa šetšwe mošomo wa tirišo. Dinako tša go se šome di ntšha diforeime tša bofora tšeo di swailwego ka enfelopong ya ka gare ka fao baamogedi ba di lahla.
stealth.h2p4: Nako jitter: 0-50 ms tšohanyetso lieha ka egress ho hlola latency-thehiloeng DPI.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morfer: kabo ya bogolo bja pakete, cadence ya go thuthupa, le dikgoba tša go homola di swana le moela wa go phela wa YouTube. Dihlopha tšeo di nyakago go betha ga pelo ya moromiwa di palelwa ke go swana.
stealth.h3p2: Multipath: phallo e swanago e arogane godimo ga Wi-Fi, sele, le VPN efe goba efe ye e šomago ka nako e tee. Reassembly ka seamohedi. E fenya go bopa tsela e tee.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC thanele ya mokero wa data: ge TLS e thibetšwe eupša WebRTC e šoma, Vortex e dithanele ka mokero wa DTLS-SRTP go ya go thaka ye e tsebjago.
stealth.h3p4: Dikgokagano tša Decoy: Dithulaganyo tše 3 tša go se dire selo tšeo di phetšego nako ye telele TLS go Google, YouTube, le Cloudflare. Molebeledi o bona boitshwaro bjo bo tlwaelegilego bja sephephediši.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS ka moka di rarolotšwe ka DoH go ya go Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP e bona feela HTTPS go bao ba rarollago, e sego lenaneo la kgonthe la domain.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Modiriši yo a šitišitšwego Thobela): SNI e šitišitšwe ka senotlelo seo se phatlaladitšwego ka gare ga rekoto ya DNS HTTPS. Babogedi ba go se dire selo ga ba kgone go bona leina la moamogedi la lefelo leo ba yago go lona.
stealth.h4p3: Probe phumano: node latedisa dikgopelo le ha ho auth session. Dinyakišišo tše tharo tše di paletšwego go tšwa go IP ka 5 min di hlohleletša mokgwa wa "decoy site" — gore IP bjale o bona letlakala la go fihla la HTML le le hlakahlakanego le 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm): deterministic domain name jenereithara seeded le letsatsi la kajeno. Ge e le gore ntlha ya mafelelo ya mathomo e thibetšwe, bareki ba bala nkgetheng yo a latelago gomme ba leka.
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: maemo a V2Ray-mokhoa dinamelwa le pluggable JSON config.
stealth.h5p2: Nnete: TLS-ka gare ga-TLS thanele. Diphetho tša go swarana ka diatla tša ka ntle www.microsoft.com; go swarana ka diatla ka gare ke Vortex. Dinyakišišo kgahlanong le tša ka ntle di fetišetšwa go Microsoft ka fao go nyakišiša ka mafolofolo ga go utolle selo.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: diphensele tša baithaopi di fetišetša sephethephethe sa Vortex godimo ga WebRTC. Badiriši bao ba tsenyago katoloso ya Snowflake ba fa sekhurumetšo.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: e fetoša di-probe tša HTTPS gore di kopane le boitshwaro bja Chromium ka noši go fihla go microsecond.
stealth.h6p1: Ditirelo tša eiee: node ye nngwe le ye nngwe e ipea pepentšha gape bjalo ka `.eie`. Bareki bao ba nago le thekgo ya Tor ba wela go se ge tše dingwe ka moka di palelwa.
stealth.h6p2: Blind Mailbox Protocol (BMP): boloka-le-pele bakeng sa melaetsa e sa tsejoeng. Bona BMP kgaolo.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay: melaetsa ka bounce ka ho fihlela ho 5 mahareng nodes, e mong le e eketsa lera la enfelopo. Jwalo ka Tor empa ka letlooeng la rona.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): go hlokomologa HTTP ka relay. Ga go na mokgatlo o tee wo o bonago bobedi kgopelo le karabo.
stealth.h1_a: Stealth e rulagantšwe bjalo ka magato a mahlano a ikemetšego. Llaga e nngwe le e nngwe e fenya sehlopha se se fapanego sa lenaba. Go palelwa ga legato le tee go senyega go ya go ye e latelago - ga e cascade.
stealth.h1_b: Llaga ya 1 e normalise kgatišo ya rena ya menwana ya TLS ka fao go se dire selo DPI ga e kgone go hlopha. Llaga ya 2 e morphs sebopego sa sephethephethe gore se bonagale bjalo ka go phallela. Llaga 3 camouflages prothokholo ka ECH / DoH / probe-karabelo maqheka. Llaga 4 switjha ho pluggable dipalangwang (vmess, 'nete, Snowflake) ha mantlha e ka mafolofolo thibetsoe. Llaga 5 ke qetellong-mohato: Tor onion, BMP, multi-hop relay.
stealth.h1_c: Mohlala wa lera o tšwa go mohlwaela wa Tor wa pluggable-transports (2013). Vortex o ile a tlaleletša ka dikarolo tše hlano go e na le tše tharo tša Tor ka gobane ka 2025 sebopego sa naga sa kganetšo se be se akaretša DPI yeo e lemogilego dinamelwa tša Tor ka botšona (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Llaga e nngwe le e nngwe ya Vortex e ile ya tsebagatšwa ka morago ga tiragalo ya tšhemo: L1 ka morago ga go thibela ga Kazakhstan (go lekana le 2019), L2 ka morago ga go gatelela ga Iran ka 2022, L3 ka morago ga go lemogwa ga DoH ga China ka 2020, L4 ka morago ga go thibela ga Turkey ka 2023, L5 ka go itokišetša.
stealth.h1_f:
Sehlopha sa lenaba | E fentšwe ke
------------------- | ----------- .
go se dire selo DPI | L1 (kgatišo ya menwana) .
tshekatsheko ya sephethephethe | L2 (sebopego) .
mafolofolo DPI | L3 (go iphihla) .
go thibela ka IP | L4 (dinamelwa) .
se sengwe le se sengwe | L5 (eie / BMP) .
stealth.h2_a: Llaga ya 1 e dira gore sephethephethe sa Vortex se se ke sa hlaolega go tšwa go Chrome go Windows 11 go legato la TLS.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello otara, katoloso lenane, cipher sutu lenane, ALPN boleng — tsohle tuned ho tšoana le Chrome 120 o tobileng bytes. JA3/JA4 hash e swana le tokollo ya bjale ya Chrome. TLS rekoto padding ho 16 KB. Moromiši wa seelo sa go se fetoge o ntšha foreime e tee N ms ye nngwe le ye nngwe ka dilo tša go tlatša tša bofora nakong ya go se dire selo. Nako jitter 0-50 ms ho hlola latency and analysis. Dikgokagano tša Decoy go Google, YouTube, Cloudflare di kitima ka morago ka dikgao tša 45 s.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 kgatišo ya menwana e phatlaladitšwe ke baentšeneare ba Salesforce ka 2017. Ka 2019 e be e le maemo a kgwebo DPI. Go tlwaetša ga kgatišo ya menwana ya Vortex go swantšhwa ka uTLS, e lego bokgobapuku bja Go bjoo Snowflake e bo šomišago ka morero o swanago. Baromiši ba seelo sa ka mehla ke boema-kepe bjo bo lebanyago bja tšhišinyo ya "sephethephethe sa go khupetša" ya WireGuard.
stealth.h2_f:
MorekiDumela dibaete = chrome_120_thempleite le { .
  tšohanyetso = rona tšohanyetso, .
  server_name = leina la rena la moamogedi (goba ECH-le phuthetšwe), .
  session_id = id ya rona ya session, .
} .
JA4 = t13d_xxxx_xxxx_xxxx (e swana le Chrome ya bjale e tsepamego)
stealth.h3_a: Llaga ya 2 e morphs sephethephethe gore se bonagale bjalo ka methopo ya ditaba ya go phallela ka bontši go e na le poledišano ya tirišano.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morfer: kabo ya bogolo bja pakete e swana le molapo wa go phela wa YouTube wa 720p (tafola ya diphihlelo), dipapadi tša cadence tša go thuthupa, papadi ya dikgoba tša go homola. Multipath: moela o swanago o kwagalago o arogane godimo ga Wi-Fi, sele, le VPN efe goba efe ye e šomago ka nako e tee; seamohedi reassembles ka tatelano nomoro tatelano. WebRTC ya data kanale fallback: ha TLS e thibetsoe empa WebRTC e feta, thanele Vortex ka DTLS-SRTP ya data kanale ho thaka tsejoang.
stealth.h3_c: Dinyakišišo tša go fetoga ga sephethephethe di boela morago go Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 e e phethagaditše bjalo ka mokgwa wa yona wa ka fasana wa "morph" ka 2014. Meek+domain-fronting e re rutile gore sebopego se bohlokwa go swana le go šitiša. YouTube-ka go lebanya e ile ya kgethwa ka gobane ke sebaka se tee se segolo kudu seo se sa thibelwego ka dinetweke tše dintši tše di thibelago — go iphihla ka gare ga sephethephethe sa sebopego sa YouTube ke "go iphihla ka gare ga lešaba".
stealth.h3_f:
pakete_boholo [ke] ~ P (boholo | YT-720p) .
romela_tiego [ke] ~ P (tiego | YT-720p)
dummy_frames tsentšwe nakong ya go se šome go boloka sebopego sa enfelopo
stealth.h4_a: Llaga 3 camouflages boitsebiso prothokholo ka boeona e - SNI, DNS, dikhoutu karabelo.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS ka moka e feta ka DNS-godimo ga-HTTPS go ya go Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ISP o bona fela HTTPS go ba rarollago bao. ECH (RFC 9460): SNI e šitišitšwe ka senotlelo seo se phatlaladitšwego ka gare ga rekoto ya DNS HTTPS. Babogedi ba go se dire selo ba bona fela IP ya ka pele. Probe phumano: nodes latedisa unauth'd IPs otla ` / api / *`; go palelwa ga tharo ka 5 min flip IP go "decoy mokgwa wa" — gore IP bjale o bona letlakala la go fihla la HTML leo le sa fetogego ka 200 OK. DGA: deterministic domain name jenereithara seeded le letsatsi la kajeno kahoo bareki fumana fallback ha mantlha e thibetsoe.
stealth.h4_c: DoH thakgolwa ka Firefox 2018 gomme ya ba default bakeng sa Chrome ka 2019. ECH ile ka dithalwa tse hlano pele standardization ka 2024 — Vortex romelwa tšehetso nakong moralo-13 le hona joale tšehetsa spec ho qetela. Di-decoy tša go arabela di-probe di adimilwe go tšwa go tlhamo ya 2014 ya meek gomme tša hlwekišwa ka 2023 ka morago ga gore di-prober tše di šomago tša Iran di hlaotše di- meek ka nako ya yona ya karabelo.
stealth.h5_a: Llaga 4 sebelisa pluggable dipalangwang - mokga boraro dithanele hore sheba joaloka ntho e 'ngoe ka ho feletseng.
stealth.h5_b: vmess / vless / trojan: maemo a V2Ray-mokhoa outbound dinamelwa; go beakanya JSON. Nnete: TLS-ka gare ga-TLS thanele moo go swarana ka diatla ka ntle go nepišago www.microsoft.com; go swarana ka diatla ka gare ke Vortex. Di-probe tše di šomago go ya ka ntle di fetišetšwa go Microsoft, ka gona go nyakišiša ga go utolle selo. Snowflake: diphensele tša baithaopi di fetišetša Vortex godimo ga WebRTC; ga go na infra ka lehlakoreng la rena. NaiveProxy: e fetoša di-probe tša HTTPS go kopana le boitshwaro bjo bo nepagetšego bja Chromium.
stealth.h5_c: V2Ray ya VMess e ile ya tsebagatšwa ka 2015 ke setšhaba sa China sa go lwantšha go hlahloba. Trojan thakgolwa ka 2019. Nnete ke ho tloha 2022 — karabelo ho Great Firewall o TLS kgatiso ya menwana phumano. Snowflake ke legato la Tor Project la 2020 la obfs4; Vortex e okeditše thekgo go v0.0.9 ka morago ga thibelo ya tekanyo e tletšego ya Iran ya 2023 ya dintlha tša go tsena tša Tor.
stealth.h5_f:
nnete inbound mohlala:
  Leina la seva: www.microsoft.com
  dest: www.microsoft.com: 443. Setswana se segolo
  shortIds: ["<go sa rulaganyetšwa>"]
moreki o kgokagana le IP ya rena, SNI=www.microsoft.com, re moemedi wa karabelo ya nnete ya Microsoft
ge e ba tsela e swana le shortId+auth ⇒ tsela go ya go Vortex .
stealth.h6_a: Llaga 5 ke mokotla wa mafelelo wa maqheka: tirelo ya onion, BMP lebenkele-le-pele, multi-hop relay, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Node e nngwe le e nngwe e phatlalatša aterese ya `.onion`. Bareki bao ba nago le moamogedi wa Tor-bokgoni ba wela ka ge TLS + L1-L4 ka moka di palelwa. BMP (Blind Mailbox Protocol): moromisi o lahlela blob encrypted ka node efe kapa efe keyed ke `HKDF (moamohedi_pubkey, "bmp-v1")`; lesebo le a phatlalatša; moamogedi o goga go tšwa go node ya bona ya gae. Multi-hop: melaetsa bounce ka ho fihlela ho 5 mahareng nodes, e mong le e eketsa lera la enfelopo - joaloka Tor empa ka hare ho letlooeng rona. OHTTP (RFC 9458): oblivious HTTP ka relay kahoo ha ho mokga o le mong o bonang bobeli kopo le karabelo.
stealth.h6_c: Ditirelo tša onion di thomile ka 2004 ka Tor. BMP ke tlhamo ya rena, yeo e ekišitšwego ka lesebo la tlhaloši ya tirelo ye e utilwego ya Tor. Multi-hop relay liipone Signal o tiisitsoeng-moromisi plus onion tsela. OHTTP e tšwa ka 2024, e hlamilwe ke Cloudflare le Apple bakeng sa telemetry yeo e bolokago sephiri; re e amogetše ka v0.0.9 bjalo ka fallback ya mafelelo.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP lebokose_a poso_id = HKDF (moamohedi_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Peeletšo: POST / bmp / depositi { lebokose la poso_id, blob }
Pickup: GET / bmp / melaetsa (auth'd)
TTL: 7200 s |  Max blob: 1 MB |  Max ka node: 500 MB .

bmp.title: Protocol ya Lepokisi la Poso la Sefofu
bmp.subtitle: Anonymous boloka-le-pele bakeng sa melaetsa ka lesebo letlooeng.
bmp.intro: BMP e dumelela moromiši a bea molaetša go node efe goba efe ntle le go utolla boitšhupo. Molaetša o a seba go fihlela o fihla node ya gae ya moamogedi, moo o hlathollago bjalo ka mehleng.
bmp.h1p1: Moromiši o hwetša `mailbox_id = HKDF (moamogedi_pubkey, info: "bmp-v1", len: 32)`. Ke feela moromiši (yo a tsebago recipient_pubkey) yo a ka e bala; moamogedi le yena o a tseba.
bmp.h1p2: Moromiši o romela `POST /bmp/deposit` ka `{mailbox_id, blob}` go node efe goba efe ya go seba.
bmp.h1p3: Node boloka para bakeng sa ho fihlela ho 7200 s. Node e akaretša gape le mailbox_id ka go sefa ya Bloom ya go dikologa ye e latelago ya lesebo.
bmp.h1p4: Di-node tše dingwe di goga di-blob bakeng sa mailbox_ids tšeo di nago le taba le tšona ka mo nageng (baamogedi go node ya bona).
bmp.h1p5: Moreki wa moamogedi o dira dipoelo tša `GET /bmp/messages` gomme o hlatholla di-blob dife goba dife tše mpsha ka dilo tša yona tša senotlelo tše di tlwaelegilego.
bmp.h2p1: Ga go na node yeo e ka kgokaganyago blob le moromiši — kgokagano ya TLS ya moromiši e hlaola mothopo IP, eupša ketane ya di-onion hops magareng ga moromiši le node ya mathomo ya BMP e tloša seo le sona.
bmp.h2p2: Moamogedi-go pata: blob e šitišitšwe ka pubkey ya moamogedi. Di-node tša magareng di bona fela thapo ya baite ye e sa bonagalego gabotse le mailbox_id ya go se kgethe.
bmp.h2p3: Ga go na tiišetšo ya thomelo go moromiši. Semantiki ka nako e tee.
bmp.h3p1: Max blob boholo: 1 MB. Dipeelo tše kgolo di swanetše go chunked ka phallo ya faele ye e tlwaelegilego.
bmp.h3p2: Max polokelo ka node: 500 MB ya dipeeletso ka palo yohle. LRU go rakwa ka cap. Badiriši ba ka tune.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: ka-IP depositi sekhahla lekanyelitsoeng ho 10 / mets. Di-ID tša lepokisi la poso tšeo di hlokometšwego ka makga a fetago a 3 / iri go node e tee di lekanyeditšwe ka seelo bjalo ka mafula ao a belaetšwago.
bmp.h4p1: Baamogedi ba go hlahlobja ga godimo: moromi ga a hloke go tseba node ya gae ya moamogedi.
bmp.h4p2: Kgokagano ya go kgaotša: di-blob di leta go fihlela moamogedi a kgokagana gape le go dira dikgetho.
bmp.h4p3: Anonymous whistleblowing: onion-lehlakoreng la moromisi + BMP = ha ho metadata ya gore ke mang yo a beilego eng.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ke legato la go boloka le go fetišetša pele leo le sa tsebjego. Moromiši o lahlela blob go node efe goba efe yeo e kgontšhitšwego ke lesebo; blob e leta ka lepokisi la poso leo le tsentšwego ka senotlelo fela go senotlelo sa setšhaba sa moamogedi.
bmp.h1_b: Moromiši o bala `mailbox_id = HKDF (moamogedi_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Ke motho feela yo a tsebago `recipient_pubkey` yo a ka e bala — moamogedi o a tseba, moromiši o a tseba, motho wa boraro ga a tsebe. Moromiši o POST `{mailbox_id, blob}` go noutu efe goba efe ya go seba. Node boloka para bakeng sa ho fihlela ho 7200 s (2 h), le tsebisa mailbox_id ka latelang lesebo phapanyetsano Bloom filtara. Di-node tše dingwe tšeo di bonago mailbox_id yeo e swanago ka mo nageng le lepokisi la poso leo le bolokilwego la mosediriši di goga blob gomme di fetišetša pele go moreki yoo wa mosediriši.
bmp.h1_c: BMP e hlamilwe go tloga mathomong ke sehlopha sa Vortex. Re e agile ka gobane ga go na moromiwa wa go tlwaelega yo a bego a ikemišeditše go diriša methopo yeo e nyakegago go uta metadata mafelelong go ya mafelelong — setšweletšwa se sengwe le se sengwe se segolo se be se romela go šitiša dikagare eupša se tlogetše legato la go tliša le bulegile, ka fao seva e be e sa tseba gore ke mang yo a bolelago le mang le neng. Ka gare ga sehlopha re be re dula re re "moromiwa yo a šireletšegilego yo a dutlelago kerafo ya leago o šireletšegile seripagare fela." BMP ke karabo ya rena: moromiši, moamogedi, le diteng ka moka di fetoga tšeo di sa bonagalego gabotse; ga go na node e tee ka gare ga letlooa yeo e swarago diripana tše di lekanego go aga poledišano lefsa. E kitima godimo ga lešela la lesebo la Vortex ka noši go e na le mananeokgoparara ao a kgomaretšwego ka dibolote, e lego seo se dirilego gore ditshenyagalelo tša kgwebo di be le tlhaologanyo gomme tlhamo e hlahlobje ka gare ga ntlo.
bmp.h1_f:
id_ya_poso = HKDF (senotlolo_sa_moamohedi, info = "bmp-v1", len = 32)

Depositi: POST / bmp / depositi { lebokose la poso_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Tsebiša: lesebo Bloom filtara += lepokisi la poso_id
Pickup: GET / bmp / melaetsa (auth'd) → blobs bakeng sa mosebedisi mailbox_ids
TTL: 7200 s |  ka-node polokelo cap: 500 MB |  sekhahla sa depositi: 10 / mets / IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP e fana ka dithoto tše tharo tše di ikemetšego tša sephiri: go uta moromiši, go uta moamogedi, go uta diteng.
bmp.h2_b: Moromiši-go uta: TLS kgokagano go node ya go bea e utolla mohlodi IP; go oketša Tor hop goba ketane yeo e sepetšwago ke onion go node ya mathomo ya BMP go tloša seo. Moamohedi-pata: mailbox_id ke tsela e le 'ngoe hash ya moamoheli_pubkey salted le BMP phetolelo khoele - e bohareng node bona opaque 32-byte sešupo. Content-hiding: blob e se e E2E-encrypted bakeng sa moamoheli sebelisa tloaelehileng Vortex kamoreng / DM dinotlelo, kahoo node bohareng bona feela ciphertext.
bmp.h2_c: Sebopego sa dithoto tše tharo ke ka fao Pond e hlalositšego dipakane tša yona ka 2014. Vortex e e hlwekišitše ka go dira gore mailbox_id e kgone go thulana (256-bit hash) gore badiriši ba babedi bao ba sa amanago ba se kgone go abelana lepokisi la poso ka phošo. The 7200-metsotswana TTL tsoa ho hlokomela hore 95 % ya baamoheli ka beta rona hula ka hare ho 2 h; e telele TTL inflated ka-node polokelo ntle le hlokomelehang pelehi phaello.
bmp.h2_f:
Lenaba leo le bonago mmušo wa node:
  - o tseba mailbox_id e gona ka nako T
  - na NOT tseba moromiši (e be e le TLS/Tor hop kgole)
  - na NOT tseba moamoheli (mailbox_id ke tsela e le 'ngoe hash)
  - na NOT tseba diteng (blob e E2E-encrypted)
bmp.h3_a: Meedi e thata ya bogolo bja blob, polokelo ya node ka e tee, le seelo sa peeletšo di boloka BMP e se fetoge lerothi le le hwilego bakeng sa ya data ya boithatelo.
bmp.h3_b: Max blob boholo: 1 MB. Dipeelo tše kgolo di swanetše go chunk ka tshepedišo ya faele ye e tlwaelegilego, yeo e nago le tsela ya yona ya polokelo. Max ka-node polokelo: 500 MB palo yohle ya BMP dipeeletšo. Ha cap e fihlellwa, khale ka ho fetisisa-pele ho rakwa marotholi blobs pele bona TTL — opareitara e ka fetola ka `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Sekhahla sa depositi ka IP: 10 ka motsotso, ho hanyetsa mafula ho tloha mohlaseli e le 'ngoe. Di-ID tša lepokisi la poso tšeo di hlokometšwego ka makga a go feta a 3/iri go ralala le netiweke di lekanyeditšwe ka seelo bjalo ka "sepheo sa mafula seo se belaetšwago".
bmp.h3_c: The 1 MB blob cap e tšoana le IRC DCC-romela dikopano le Signal o tiisitsoeng-moromili cap, e khōlō ka ho lekaneng bakeng sa melaetsa e khutšoanyane le litšoantšo tse nyenyane, e nyenyane ka ho lekaneng hore mohlaseli a ke ke a sebelisa BMP bakeng sa faele hosting. 500 MB ka-node ke OSS-default e utloahalang; badiriši ba bagolo ba e godiša ka `BMP_MAX_BYTES`. Meedi ya seelo e tlile ka morago ga beta ya v0.0.8 moo sengwalwa sa teko ya mohlahlobi se ilego sa tlatša di-node tše 50 ka dipeeletšo ka metsotso e 20.
bmp.h3_f:
mellwane: .
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB .
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB .
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # ka motsotso ka IP .
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # id_ya lepokisi la poso le le swanago ka iri
bmp.h4_a: BMP e phadima ka maemo a mararo: baamogedi ba godimo ba go hlahlobja, kgokagano ya go kgaotša, go tšholla ditaba ka go se tsebje.
bmp.h4_b: High-censorship: moromiši ga a tsebe node ya gae ya moamogedi (gomme mo gongwe a ka se kgone go e fihlelela go le bjalo). Drop ka thaka efe kapa efe, tlohela lesebo tsela. Kgokagano ya go kgaotša: moamogedi o ka ntle ga inthanete ka diiri tše dintši; blob e leta, ga go nyakege go leka gape. Go tšholla mo go sa tsebjego: onion ya lehlakore la moromiši + BMP = ga go na metadata mabapi le gore ke mang yo a beilego eng. Ge e kopantšwe le senotlelo sa phapoši seo se tsebjago feela ke mekgatlo yeo e botegago, diteng le tšona ga di bonagale gabotse go sedirišwa le ge e le sefe sa go thibela.
bmp.h4_c: Dikgetse tše tharo tša tšhomišo di latela dihlohleletšo tša histori tša marothodi a hwilego a bohlodi bja mmele (mehla ya Soviet), ya `alt.anonymous.messages` go Usenet (1990s), le ya SecureDrop (2013 go ya pele). BMP ke maiteko a rena a go tliša histori yeo ka gare ga moromiwa wa sebjalebjale ntle le go nyaka sedirišwa se se arogilego.

push.title: Ditsebišo tša go kgorometša
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Web Push — ka moka ka dienfelopo tše di tswaletšwego gore baabi ba se kgone go bala.
push.intro: Standard kgorometsa ditshebeletso (APNs, FCM, Web Push) bona mong le e mong payload. Vortex e phuthela tsebišo ye nngwe le ye nngwe ka legato la E2E le le arogilego ka fao moabi o bona fela blob ye e sa bonagalego gabotse yeo e se nago id ya phapoši, moromiši, goba sengwalwa.
push.h1p1: Moreki o hwetša leswao la sefala (pontšho ya sedirišwa sa APNs, FCM id ya ngwadišo, goba peeletšo ya Web Push JWT).
push.h1p2: Moreki o tšweletša senotlolo se sefsa sa 32-byte X25519 `p256dh_pub` le sephiri sa 16-byte `auth`. POSTs ` / api / kgorometša / ingwadiše` ka ` {ntlha ya mafelelo, p256dh, auth, sefala}`.
push.h1p3: Node phegelela ` kgorometša_dipeeletšo (modiriši_id, ntlha ya mafelelo, p256dh, auth, sefala, bōpiloe_ka)`.
push.h2p1: Ge tsebišo e swanetše go fihla (molaetša o mofsa ka phapošing yeo e kgaoditšwego yeo e beakantšwego go tsebiša, go bolela, go bitša go laletša), node e šitiša mošomo wa go lefa ka AES-GCM e diriša senotlelo seo se tšwago go `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` ka HKDF.
push.h2p2: Node diphuthelwana `{ntlha ya mafelelo, TTL, go akgofa, hlogotaba: <collapse_key>, ya data: <ciphertext>}` le go romela go APNs / FCM / Web Push seva.
push.h2p3: Moabi o bona fela `data` (sengwalwa sa sephiri) + `hlogotaba`. Ga go na go dutla ga sengwalwa se se sa hlakahlakanego.
push.h3p1: Senotlelo sa hlogotaba ka phapoši: `phapoši:<id>`. Melaetša ye mentši ka phapošing e tee e phuhlama go tsebišo e tee maemong a OS.
push.h3p2: Ka-call sehlooho: `pitso: <id>`. Go araba goba go gana go goga sefoka; ditaletšo tše mpsha tša go bitša ka phapošing e tee di tšeela ya kgale legato.
push.h4p1: iOS: Tsebišo Tirelo Katološo decrypts ka NSE tshebetso (arohane le tiriso ye ka sehloohong). E šomiša di-primitive tša CryptoKit tše di swanago.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService e hlatholla ka tirelong ya morago. JobScheduler dithulaganyo sebele UI update lam ha tiriso ye e foregrounded.
push.h4p3: Web: Mošomi wa Tirelo o hlatholla ka gare ga seemo sa SW, o romela tsebišo ya selegae ka Ditsebišo tša Wepe API.
push.h5: Di-quirk tše di itšego tša moabi
push.h5p1: APNs: hloka mofani wa letšoao hlaphoheloa mong le e mong 60 mets. Token hlabolla e jarolla ka ho iketsa ka Apple o `auth-sehlopha-id` + `auth-senotlolo-id` + p8 senotlolo faele.
push.h5p2: FCM: bohwa HTTP ntlha ya mafelelo e sa nyakege; re šomiša ntlha ya mafelelo ya HTTP v1 ka ditšhupetšo tša akhaonto ya tirelo ya OAuth2. Dikološa mong le e mong 1 h.
push.h5p3: Web Push: VAPID dinotlelo (para e le nngwe ya dinotlelo ka node). TTL capped ka matšatši a 28 ke bontši bja diphensele.
push.h1_a: Moreki o ngwadiša leswao la sedirišwa (APNs/FCM/Web Push) mmogo le senotlelo sa setšhaba se sefsa sa X25519 le sephiri sa auth sa 16-byte.
push.h1_b: Moreki o tšweletša `p256dh_priv = rand (32)` le `auth = rand (16)`. E hwetša ` p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs ` / api / kgorometša / ingwadiše` ka ` {ntlha ya mafelelo, p256dh, auth, sefala, mosebedisi_moemedi}`. Node phegelela ` kgorometša_dipeeletšo (modiriši_id, ntlha ya mafelelo, p256dh, auth, sefala, bōpiloe_ka, ho qetela_hlabofatswa_ka)`. Dikološo: moreki o ingwadiša gape go thakgolwa ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya tirišo, yeo e hlabollago `last_refreshed_at`. Dipeeletšo tša kgale go feta matšatši a 30 di a hlwekišwa.
push.h1_c: Mabala a p256dh + auth a tšwa go Web Push RFC 8291 (2017). Re di šomišitše gape bakeng sa di-APN le FCM le ge ditirelo tšeo di sa nyake sebopego se se tswaletšwego — go dira bjalo go boloka tsela e tee ya khoutu go ralala le tše tharo ka moka. Pele v0.0.5 Vortex e rometše merwalo ya mongwalo wo o sa hlakahlakanego ka ditirelo tša go kgorometša; ka morago ga Apple ya 2022 kgorometša sephiri mpshafatšo le tiragalo ye e arogilego moo projeke ya FCM yeo e sa rulaganywago gabotse e ilego ya dutlela ditsebišo, re ile ra hudušetša se sengwe le se sengwe go dienfelopo tše di tswaletšwego.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = ranta (32) .
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519 .
auth = ranta (16) .

POST /api / kgorometša / ingwadiše
  { ntlha ya mafelelo, p256dh: hex (p256dh_pub), auth: hex (auth), sethaleng }
push.h2_a: Ge tsebišo e swanetše go fihla, node e šitiša mošomo wa mohola ka fao ke sedirišwa sa moamogedi fela seo se ka o balago. Tirelo ya go kgorometša (Apple / Google / Mozilla) e bona feela blob yeo e sa bonagalego gabotse.
push.h2_b: Node e kgetha keypair ya nakwana ya X25519. E hwetša `ikm = ECDH (priv_ya nakwana, p256dh_pub)`. Matha HKDF (letsoai = auth, ikm, info = "aesgcm", len = 32) → senotlolo. Encrypts `{thaetlele, 'mele, room_id, molaetsa_id}` e le CBOR → AES-GCM le senotlolo fumanehang + tšohanyetso 96-bit nonce. E romela `{ntlha ya mafelelo, TTL, go akgofa, hlogotaba: senotlolo_sa_go phuhlama, ya data: sengwalwa sa sephiri, aes128gcm: {letswai, pub_ephemeral}}` go APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Sesebediswa amohela, katoloso / tšebeletso mosebetsi matha e tšoanang senotlolo derivation ka khutlisetsa, decrypts, bontša tsebiso.
push.h2_c: Kgorometšo ye e tiišitšwego ke ka go lebanya spec ya Encryption ya Molaetša wa Kgorometša wa Wepe go tšwa go 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple ya 2022 iOS 16 update lam ekeditse thekgo ya maemo a pele bakeng sa dikatoloso tšebeletso ya tsebiso e etsa decryption; Android e e thekgile ka melaetša ya data ya FCM ka mengwaga. Vortex ke e mong oa baromiwa ba seng mekae hore phethahatsa phallo e feletseng le khoutu e tšoanang ka diforamo tsohle tse tharo — iOS sebelisa `NotificationServiceExtension`, Android sebelisa `FirebaseMessagingService`, Web sebelisa mosebetsi oa tšebeletso.
push.h2_f:
ephemeral_priv = ranta (32);  ephemeral_pub = ya nakwana_priv · G
ikm = ECDH (priv_ya nakwana, p256dh_pub) .
prk = HMAC-SHA256 (boitsebišo, ikm) .
senotlolo = HKDF-Atolosa (prk, "Diteng-Encoding: aes128gcm \ x00", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Atološa (prk, "Go ngwala khoutu ya diteng: nonce \ x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt (senotlolo, nonce, mojaro o moholo)
romela { ntlha ya mafelelo, ya data: letswai∥rekhoto_boholo∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct }
push.h3_a: Dinotlelo tša go phuhlama di thibela ditsebišo tše ntši go tšwa poledišanong ye e swanago go kgoboketšwa bjalo ka difolaga ka botee — OS e di kopanya go ba e tee.
push.h3_b: Ka-kamore e phuhlama: sehlooho = `kamore: <id>`. `apns-collapse-id` ya di-APN le `collapse_key` ya FCM di botša OS go tšeela ditsebišo tša pele legato ka hlogotaba ye e swanago. Modiriši o bona sefoka se tee ka phapošing go sa šetšwe gore go fihla melaetša ye mekae. Ka-pitšo phuhlama: sehlooho = `pitso: <id>`; ditaletšo tše mpsha tša mogala ka phapošing e tee di tšeela tša peleng legato. Ka-bolela: sehlooho = `bolela: <mosebedisi>: <phaposi>`; e mong bolela banner ka mosebedisi-kamore para.
push.h3_c: Dinotlelo tša go phuhlama di ile tša okeletšwa go di-APN go iOS 10 (2016) le go FCM ka 2014. Pele ga moo, go thuthupa ga melaetša e mentši go ile gwa tšweletša mekgobo ya difolaga tše dintši yeo badiriši ba bego ba e hloile ka go swana. Telegram e bile mmulamadibogo wa go phuhlama ga phapoši e nngwe le e nngwe UX ka 2015; motseta yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo mogolo o ile a latela. Vortex ya arohana ka kamoreng / bitsa / bolela ho phuhlama e tlile ho tloha mosebedisi ditshwaelo ka v0.0.6 beta hore "pitso mema nka sebaka sa moqoqo banner" ikutloa e fosahetseng — dihlooho tse arohaneng lokisa eona.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-go phuhlama-id = phapoši: 42 → e tšea sebaka sa difolaga tša pele
FCM: collapse_key = bitša:17 → e tšea sebaka sa difolaga tša pele
Web: sehlooho = bolela:u12: r5 → nka sebaka sa pele difolaga
push.h4_a: Sethala se sengwe le se sengwe se na le di-gotcha tša sona. iOS e hloka Katološo ya Tirelo ya Tsebišo; Android hloka FCM melaetsa ya data; Web hloka mošomi wa tirelo + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: sehlopha sa tirišo se romela sepheo sa `NotificationServiceExtension`. System e fana ka payload encrypted ho NSE; NSE e na le 30 s ya CPU + 25 MB ya memori ya go hlatholla le go fetoša tsebišo pele e bontšhwa. FCM: re romela `data` melaetsa (eseng `tsebiso`) kahoo tiriso ye FirebaseMessagingService matha ka fihla — hore re fa taolo ya hore na ho bontša banner. Web Push: mošomi wa tirelo o thibela ditiragalo tša `kgorometša`, o hlatholla, o bontšha ka `self.registration.showNotification`.
push.h4_c: Mohlala wa NSE o ile wa tsebagatšwa ke Apple go iOS 10 (2016) ka go lebanya bakeng sa ditiragalo tša tšhomišo ya go hlatholla molaetša. Pele ga moo, baromiwa bao ba šitišitšwego go tloga mafelelong go ya mafelelong ba be ba swanetše go kgetha magareng ga merwalo ya go kgorometša ya mongwalo o sa hlakahlakanego (go ba le bonaba bja sephiri) le go kgorometša ga dipetšhe feela (UX-bonaba). WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram ka moka di ile tša tlolela di-NSE ka gare ga ngwaga. Vortex e latela mohlala o tšoanang.
push.h5_a: Mofani wa di-quirks itseng - karolo ya kgaolo ya kgorometsa. Ye ke ye nngwe ya mekgwa ya motheo yeo e šupšago go ralala le tšhupetšo ya Vortex. Bala kgaolo ye e e dikologilego bakeng sa taba ye e nabilego; karolo ye e godiša boitshwaro bjo bo itšego.
push.h5_b: Kakaretšo ya phethagatšo ya "Di-quirk tše di itšego tša moabi". Mokgwa o phethagatšwa ka modula wo o swanetšego ka fase ga `app/`, `ios/Dimojule/Methopo/`, goba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Mojule wa README o bitša ditsela tša faele tše di nepagetšego.
push.h5_c: Mokgwa wa "Di-quirk tše di itšego tša moabi" o ile wa tšwelela go ralala le ditokollo tša Vortex. Moralo o latela morago go nyakišišo ye e phatlaladitšwego le mekgwa ya tšweletšo ya baromiwa ba peleng. Histori ya phetolelo ka go `CHANGELOG.md` e rekota gore seripa se sengwe le se sengwe se ile sa kotama neng le seo se se hlohleleditšego.

controller.title: Tirelo ya molaodi
controller.subtitle: Bohlatse bja botshepegi, kutollo ya go tsena, go hlokomela maphelo.
controller.intro: Molaodi ke tshepedišo ya Python ye e arogilego. Bokagodimo bja yona bja tlhaselo ke bjo bonnyane (ditsela tše ka bago tše lesomepedi) gomme go bota ga yona go kgomaretšwe go senotlelo se tee sa setšhaba sa Ed25519 seo se apeilwego ka gare ga bareki.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/botshepehi` — sephetho sa bopaki. Sekema: `{boemo, saennwe_ka, tshepo_pubkey, phetolelo, hahiloeng_ka, tšoanang, sa tšoanang, sieo, eketsehileng, molaetsa}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1 / bophelo bo botle` — phela. Sekema: `{boemo: "ok", phetolelo, pubkey, stats: {online, amohetsweng, palo yohle}}`.
controller.h1p3: `GET /v1/entries` — di-URL tša go tsena. Sekema: `[{prothokhole: "wss"|"https", url}...]`.
controller.h1p4: `GET / v1 / liipone` — balaoli ba seipone (DNS + IPFS + .onion mefuta e fapaneng).
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/go betha ga pelo/{pubkey}` — node go phela ga nyakišišo. E šomišwa ke di-node tše di kopantšwego go boloka ngwadišo ya tšona e le ye mpsha.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — node e ncha e sebetsa bakeng sa tšepo. E nyaka tumelelo ya molaodi ntle le ge `AUTO_APPROVE=therešo`.
controller.h2p1: Faele ya Manifest: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. E na le ka faele BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 mosaeno.
controller.h2p2: Moloko: `python -m vortex_molaodi.botshepegi.sedirišwa_sa_sedirišwa`. Bala senotlelo sa tokollo go tšwa go `dinotlelo/tokollo.senotlelo`, o sepela sehlare, o ngwala manifest.
controller.h2p3: Netefatšo: molaodi bala manifest ka qala le bapisa khahlanong le tiske. Startup e palelwa ka go hlaboša ka go se swane.
controller.h3p1: Diipone di sepetša khoutu ya molaodi ye e swanago ka senotlelo se se swanago sa go lokollwa seo se kopišitšwego godimo. Bareki ba bona `signed_by` e tšoanang ho pholletsa le liipone — tsela e 'ngoe ea ho lemoha seipone sa bohata ke ho bapisa di-pubkey.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS phatlalatša ditšhupetšo go e nngwe ya diipone tše mmalwa. Bareki ba leka ka tatelano ya bohlokwa ka nako ya go fela.
controller.h3p3: Tšhupetšo ya `vortex.sol-mirror/` ka go repo ye ke seipone sa trycloudflare seo se loketšego go sepela bakeng sa tlhabollo.
controller.h1_a: Molaodi wa setšhaba API bokagodimo bo ka ba lesomepedi ditsela. Ka moka tše nnyane, ka moka di lebišitšwe go bohlatse le go tsena-URL kutollo.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/botshepegi` — saennwe bontša bopaki. ` / v1 / bophelo bo botle` - phela + pubkey + stats. `/v1/entries` — di-URL tša go tsena bakeng sa go kgokaganya. `/v1/mirrors` — balaodi ba seipone. `/ v1/trusted_nodes` — dithaka tša kopano. `/ v1/go betha ga pelo/{pubkey}` — node liveness probe. `/v1/ngwadiša` — node ye mpsha e šoma bakeng sa go tshepa (tumelelo ya molaodi ntle le ge `AUTO_APPROVE = therešo`). Ke sona - ka boomo moqotetsane ho boloka tlhaselo bokagodimo bonyane.
controller.h1_c: Moralo wa bokagodimo bjo bo sesane o tsebišwa ke go hlokomela gore tshepedišo ya bohlatse e ba nepišo ya boleng bjo bo phagamego kudu ge bareki ba šetše ba kgomaretše go yona. Khoutu e nyenyane = bokagodimo bjo bonyenyane. Bapetša le node yeo e nago le ditsela tše 120+; molaodi o na le 12. Mohlala o swanago: Debian ya apt-get e tshepa tshepedišo ye nnyane ya `Release.gpg` yeo e fapanego le go amogela sephuthelwana.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` e sepela mohlareng wa mohlodi, e hashes faele e nngwe le e nngwe, e saena ka senotlolo sa tokollo, e ngola `INTEGRITY.sig.json`.
controller.h2_b: Sedirišwa se bala `dinotlelo/tokollo.senotlolo` (32-byte Ed25519 senotlolo sa poraefete). Walks `vortex_controller /` + `app /` (ntle le difaele gitignored). Bakeng sa faele e nngwe le e nngwe: `blake3 (diteng) → hash`. E aga bonagatša `{phetolelo, built_at, difaele: [{tsela, sha256, bogolo}]}`. Computes `kanonika_baete = CBOR (bontša)`. Matshwao: `sig = Ed25519-Sign (tokollo_senotlolo, canonical_bytes)`. E ngola `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {bontša, saennweng_ke: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Dimanifesto tše di saennwego di boela morago go Debian’s Release.gpg (1997) le di-tarball tša kernel tša Linux tšeo di saennwego ka PGP. Sigstore (2021) e hlwekišitše mohlala bakeng sa bohlatse bja ketane ya kabo. Phetolelo ya Vortex e bobebe kudu ka gobane e hlatsela go tsenywa tirišong ga tee, e sego ketane ya go lokollwa ga mekgatlo ye mentši. Re ka amogela Sigstore go v0.4 bakeng sa ditokollo tša setšhaba.
controller.h3_a: Diipone di sepetša khoutu ya molaodi ye e swanago ka senotlelo se se swanago sa go lokollwa. Dikeno tše ntši tša DNS / SNS / IPFS di šupa go se sengwe sa diipone tše mmalwa.
controller.h3_b: Badiriši ba hloma N liipone (ka go tlhaolega 3-5). E nngwe le e nngwe e sepetša khoutu ye e swanago ya `vortex_controller` ka `dinotlelo/release.key` ye e swanago. Bareki bona tšoanang `signed_by` ka mose liipone - e ntle sanity hlahloba. DNS/SNS/IPFS direkoto lenaneo liipone le dilo tše di tlago pele. Bareki ba leka ka tatelano ya bohlokwa, ka nako ya go fela ya metsotswana ye 7 ka maiteko. The `vortex.sol-mirror /` directory ka repo ena ke pele-wired trycloudflare seipone mohlala.
controller.h3_c: Diipone tše ntši tšeo di nago le go lebelela pele ke mohlala wo o swanago wo SMTP a o šomišago go direkhoto tša MX gomme HTTPS e o šomiša go direkhoto tša SRV. Tor's directory balaodi ba ke mohlala amanang - 9 hardcoded DAs + dikgetho. Vortex o ile a kgetha "kgetha seipone seo se šomago" go feta "bouto ya khoramo" ka gobane meralo ye e theilwego godimo ga dikgetho e kgotlelela kudu eupša e nanya kudu go bootstrap.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/botshepegi : GET → sephetho sa bohlatse
/v1 / bophelo bo botle : GET → {boemo, phetolelo, pubkey, dipalopalo}
/ v1 / dikeno : GET → [{prothokhole, url}, ...]
/v1 / liipone : GET → [molaodi_url, ...]
/ v1 / trusted_nodes : GET → [{senotlolo sa pub, ntlha ya mafelelo, bophelo bo botle}, ...]
/v1/heartbeat/{pk} : POST (go tšwa go di-node tše di ngwadišitšwego fela)
/v1/ngwadiša : POST (bakeng sa di-node tše mpsha) .
controller.h2_f:
sedirišwa = sedirišwa_sa leswao
input = mohlodi sefate, linotlolo / lokolloa.senotlolo
bonahatsa = { .
  phetolelo: "0.1.0",
  e agilwe_ka: unix_ms, .
  difaele: [{tsela, sha256, boholo}, ...]
} .
sig = Ed25519-Sign (tokollo_priv, CBOR (bontša))
dipholo tsa = INTEGRITY.sig.json = {bontša, saennweng_ka: pub_hex, sig: sig_hex}
controller.h3_f:
DNSLink TXT _dnslink.vortexx.sol: kgokagano = / ipfs / <CID>
SNS rekoto vortexx.sol: {"diipone": [url1, url2, url3]}
IPFS CID: INTEGRITY.sig.json e phepišitšwe
moreki kgetha: pele arabela ka tatelano ya pele, 7 s timeout

storage.title: Lera la polokelo
storage.subtitle: SQLite bakeng sa dev, Postgres bakeng sa prod, Alembic bakeng sa ho fallela, GRDB / Room / IndexedDB ka bareki.
storage.intro: Polokelo ya node ya Vortex ke SQL. Go fetola magareng ga SQLite (dev) le Postgres (prod) ke phetogo ya DATABASE_URL — ga go na diforoko tša khoutu.
storage.h1p1: `basebedisi (id, lebitso la mosebedisi, phasewete_hash, x25519_senotlolo_sechaba, kyber_senotlolo_sechaba?, bontša_lebitso, avatar_url, fono, imeile, bōpiloe_ka, ke_mafolofolo)` — mantlha boitsebiso tafole.
storage.h1p2: `disebediswa_mosebedisi (id, mosebedisi_id, sesebediswa_id, moemeli_mosebedisi, ho qetela_seen_at, revoked_at)` — ka-sesebediswa session mela.
storage.h1p3: `dikamore (id, mofuta, lebitso, ke_poraefete, ke_kanale, ke_dm, member_count, avatar_url, bōpiloe_ka, bōpiloe_ke, tlhaloso)` — tafole kamoreng, mola o le mong ka kamoreng.
storage.h1p4: `kamore_ditho (kamore_id, mosebedisi_id, karolo, kopanela_ka, khutsitsoeng_ho fihlela)` — boleloko + ACL.
storage.h1p5: `melaetsa (id, kamore_id, moromi_id, ciphertext, nonce, moromisi_pseudo, rometsoeng_ka, hlophisitsoeng_ka?, hlakolwa_ka?, araba_ho?, khoele_id?, mofuta)` — molaetsa o mong le o mong, indexed ka `(kamore_id, id)`.
storage.h1p6: `dikarabelo (molaetsa_id, mosebedisi_id, emoji, bōpiloe_ka)` — motsoako senotlolo mantlha ` (molaetsa_id, mosebedisi_id, emoji)`.
storage.h1p7: `difaele (id, mosebedisi_id, mime_type, boholo, sha256 /* ha e le hantle BLAKE3 */, polokelo_tsela, uploaded_at)` — faele metadata.
storage.h1p8: `bala_receipts (kamore_id, mosebedisi_id, molaetsa_id, bala_ka)` — morao-rao-bala tshupo ka mosebedisi ka kamoreng.
storage.h1p9: `go ba gona (modiriši_id, la mafelelo_bone_ka, ke_thaepa_ka_kamore_id?)` — nakwana, Redis-tšehetsoa ka prod.
storage.h1p10: `federations (pubkey, ntlha ya mafelelo, bophelo_maphelo_score, eketswa_ka, eketswa_ka, hlakolwa_ka)` — lenane la dithaka.
storage.h1p11: `federation_outbox (id, sepheo_node, payload, maiteko, next_retry_at)` — moleng o tsoang.
storage.h1p12: `melaetsa_e hlophisitsoeng (id, kamore_id, ciphertext, nonce, romela_ka, bōpiloe_ka, bōpiloe_ka, hlakolwa_ka)`.
storage.h1p13: `dikgokagano (modiriši_id, kgokagano_modiriši_id, leina la sereto, added_at)` — puku ya diaterese.
storage.h1p14: `saved_gifs (mosebedisi_id, url, bophara, bophahamo, eketswa_ka)` — ka-mosebedisi GIF pokello.
storage.h1p15: `difoldara (mosebedisi_id, id, lebitso, kamore_ids, ke_tshepedišo, bōpiloe_ka)` — difoldara moqoqo.
storage.h1p17: `dithulaganyo (jti, mosebedisi_id, sesebediswa_id, expires_at)` — hlabolla letšoao ngodiso.
storage.h1p18: ` kgorometša_dipeeletšo (modiriši_id, ntlha ya mafelelo, p256dh, auth, sefala, bōpiloe_ka)` — kgorometsa ngodiso.
storage.h2p1: Alembic ka `alembic / diphetolelo /`. Histori ya linear, poeletšo e tee ka tokollo (ka dinako tše dingwe tše mmalwa ka tokollo).
storage.h2p2: Dev mokgwa wa: `bopa_kaofela + ALTER TABLE fallback` bakeng sa iteration ka potlako.
storage.h2p3: Prod mokgwa wa: `alembic ntlafatsa hlooho` pele qala. Docker setšoantšo matha e ka entrypoint.
storage.h3p1: `melaetša (room_id, id DESC)` — tšhupamabaka ya mathomo bakeng sa go lata ka matlakala.
storage.h3p2: `melaetša (room_id, sent_at DESC)` — bakeng sa nako-thehiloeng odara ka tseleganya.
storage.h3p3: `dikarabelo (message_id)` - bakeng sa aggregation ka kamoreng bulehileng.
storage.h3p4: `bala_receipts (kamore_id, molaetsa_id)` — bakeng sa `bonwa ke N` lookups.
storage.h3p5: `user_devices (user_id)` — bakeng sa go lokeletša disebediswa mafolofolo.
storage.h3p6: FTS ditafole tša go bonagala (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) bakeng sa go nyaka sengwalwa ka botlalo.
storage.h4p1: `etsa db-backup` e hlahisa polokelo e nang le setempe sa nako. Encrypted ka phomolo le opareitara e senotlolo.
storage.h4p2: Go boloka: letšatši le letšatši ka matšatši a 14, beke le beke dibeke tše 4, kgwedi le kgwedi dikgwedi tše 12.
storage.h4p3: Tsošološo: `dira db-tsošološa FILE=<tsela>`. Matha ka sethaleng DB pele; opareitara e netefatsa ebe swaps.
storage.h1_a: Node polokelo ke SQL. SQLite bakeng sa dev le nyenyane intša hosted; PostgreSQL bakeng sa tlhahiso e kopaneng kapa multi-node. Same SQLAlchemy 2.x khoutu ya async khanna bobeli.
storage.h1_b: Config ka `DATABASE_URL = sqlite + aiosqlite:///vortex.db` goba `postgresql + asyncpg://modiriši: pw@moamogedi/db`. Single config, ha ho khoutu ya diforoko. SQLite e matha ka gare ga tshepedišo; Postgres e matha ka thoko. Tiragatšo: SQLite e swara ~ 50 badiriši ba nako e tee ka boiketlo go M1; Postgres dikala go dikete. Go huduga Postgres → SQLite ke ya tsela e tee ka `pg_dump --data-feela` + SQLite import; tlhahlo ye nngwe e a swana.
storage.h1_c: Mohlala wa "e tee ORM, di-backend tše pedi" ke mokgwa wa SQLAlchemy wa mengwaga ye lesome. Vortex e šomiša async 2.x API ka fao potšišo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e letetše. Re ile ra kgetha SQLAlchemy Core go feta Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / `asyncpg` e tala bakeng sa kanegelo ya go huduga ye e humilego le go swana le dikapolelo tša async tša FastAPI.
storage.h2_a: 18 ditafole konokono: basebedisi ba, mosebedisi_disebediswa, likamore, room_members, melaetsa, dikarabelo, difaele, bala_rasiti, ho ba teng, federations, federation_outbox, kemiso_melaetsa, mabitso, bolokwa_gifs, difoldara, bot_installations, dithulaganyo, push_dipeeletšo.
storage.h2_b: Tafole ya badiriši ke modu wa boitšhupo. room_members tšoara (kamore, mosebedisi, karolo, joined_at, muted_ho fihlela). melaetša e rwala ciphertext + metadata; indexed ka (room_id, id) bakeng sa matlakala lata. dikarabelo ke motswako-mantlha-senotlolo tafole. Se sengwe le se sengwe se otlologile. Polokelo e hōla linearly le molaetsa bala - ka hoo e ka bang 1 KB ka molaetsa ka tiske ka mor'a index ka holimo.
storage.h2_c: Sekema se be se tsepame ka morago ga v0.0.4. Pejana re be re na le ditafola tše di aroganego tša `dm_messages` le `group_messages`; e kopantšwe ka v0.0.3 ka morago ga gore khoutu ya fanout e phetoletšwe go ralala le bobedi. Ditafola tše 18 ke bonnyane bja moromiwa yo a feletšego wa tšobotsi; di-deployment tše kgolo di oketša ditafola tša ditshekatsheko eupša tšeo ga di nyakege bakeng sa tshepedišo.
storage.h3_a: Alembic o laola go huduga. Histori ya poeletšo ya mothalo, poeletšo e tee ka tokollo. Phetošo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e na le bobedi mešomo ya `go kaonafatša ()` le `go theoša ()`.
storage.h3_b: `alembic / diphetolelo /` tšoara diphetolo. E nngwe le e nngwe ke faele ya Python yeo e nago le go kaonafatša/go theoša. CI e matha `alembic ntlafatso hlooho` + `alembic downgrade -1` + `alembic ntlafatsa hlooho` ho netefatsa leeto la ho boa. Tšweletšo: `etsa db-falla` phetha ka Docker entrypoint pele tiriso ye e thoma. Dev mokgwa wa sebelisa `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` kahoo iteration e ka potlako ntle le ho hloka migrations ka mong le e mong rebase.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) ke sedirišwa sa go huduga sa SQLAlchemy sa canonical. Linear histori (eseng branching) ke kgetho - e qoba "bahlahisi ba babeli bopa e tšoanang phetolo nomoro" bothata. Dikhudugo tša Django di šomiša mokgwa o swanago. Diporo di ile tša tloga go linear go ya go timestamped ka 2014 eupša di ile tša amogela gape linear-with-merge ka 2020.
storage.h4_a: Ditšhupetšo tša senotlelo di kgethwa ka kelohloko ka fao go bala mo go fišago (melaetša, dikarabelo, dirasiti tša go bala) di otla tiske ka sewelo.
storage.h4_b: `melaetsa (room_id, id DESC)` — mantlha matlakala index. `melaetša (room_id, sent_at DESC)` — nako-o laetšwego fallback bakeng sa diphetogo. `dikarabelo (molaetsa_id)` - aggregation ka kamoreng bulehileng. `bala_receipts (kamore_id, molaetsa_id)` — "bonwa ke N" bala. `disebediswa_mosebedisi (mosebedisi_id)` — lenane la sesebediswa. FTS litafole virtual bakeng sa ho batla (FTS5 ka SQLite, tsvector ka Postgres).
storage.h4_c: Dikgetho tša tšhupamabaka di tlile go tšwa go hlaloša-thulaganyo-profile nakong ya teko ya mošomo wa v0.0.4. Re thomile ka ditšhupetšo tša naive gomme ra tlaleletša/tloša go ya ka dipaterone tša dipotšišo tše di hlokometšwego. The `melaetsa (room_id, id DESC)` ke index e le 'ngoe chesang ka ho fetisisa - hoo e ka bang 80 % ya bala otla e. Go e boloka e le ye tshesane (ga go na dikholomo tša go akaretša) go e dumelela go tsena ka gare ga memori.

bots.title: Bot tlhako ya
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + mmaraka + antispam.
bots.intro: Bots ke batšeakarolo ba phapoši ya maemo a pele. Melaetša e saennwe ka senotlelo sa Ed25519 sa bot ka fao diphošo tša bofora di a lemogwa.
bots.h1p1: Dikgetho tše pedi: Python SDK goba Gravitix DSL. Python ke ya ditshepedišo tša mošomo tše di raraganego; Gravitix bakeng sa di-bot tša poledišano tšeo di laolwago ke ditiragalo tšeo di swanetšego go romelwa ka pela.
bots.h1p2: Python mohlala: `ho tloha vortex_bot import Bot \ nbot = Bot (letshwao = ...) \ n @ bot.on_molaetsa \ nasync def echo (molaetša): leta bot.romela (molaetša.kamore_id, molaetša.sengwalwa) \ nbot.run ()`. The SDK swara WebSocket, kgokagano gape, encryption senotlolo phapanyetsano.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix mohlala: `ka / qala { emit "Dumela, {ctx.lebitso_la_pele}!" }`. E kgoboketša go bytecode gomme e šoma ka gare ga mofetoledi wa sandboxed.
bots.h1p4: Bot letšoao e ntša ka bot tlholo. Lahlehile token? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` e ntšha e mpsha.
bots.h2p1: Mehlala ye mebedi ya go tsenywa tirišong: ka gare ga tshepedišo (coroutine ka gare ga node) le ya ka ntle (bot polls `/ api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: Ka-tshebetso: lefela marangrang hop, ka potlako ka ho fetisisa, empa opareitara e lokela ho tšepa khoutu ya bot. Good bakeng sa di-bot tša bona.
bots.h2p3: Ka ntle: webhook goba nako ye telele-poll. Ga go nyakege go bota ga maemo a node. Good bakeng sa di-bot tša mokga wa boraro le mmaraka.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix bots kamehla matha ka-tshebetso ka sandbox - ba ha ba na filesystem kapa phihlello marangrang ntle le pepeneneng API.
bots.h3p1: Di-bot tša setšhaba di ka ikokobeletša mmarakeng. Basekaseki netefatša khoutu ga e phish, ga e spam, ga e dutle ya data ya mosediriši.
bots.h3p2: Categories: tšweletšo, dipapadi, ditaba, utilities, ai, phetolelo.
bots.h3p3: Tsenya: tobetsa e le nngwe. Node e ingwadišetša mosediriši go leina la mosediriši la bot ka fao di-DM di sepela ka nepo.
bots.h3p4: Monetization: mahala, nako e le nngwe reka, peeletšo. Tefiso ya sefala 10 %% ya palomoka.
bots.h4p1: Kamore e nngwe le e nngwe e beilwe leihlo ke bot ya antispam yeo e sa bonagalego. Ditlhahlobo: segokanyipalo sa kgokagano > 3 ka motsotso, tekanyo ya ditlhaka tše kgolo > 70 %% bakeng sa ditlhaka tše 10+, melaetša ya go boeletša, go thuthupa ga tšhoganetšo ga bahlakanelwa ba akhaonto ye mpsha.
bots.h4p2: Ditiro: lemoša → nako ya go fela (5 mets) → raga → thibelo. Boipiletšo bo ya go room admin.
bots.h1_a: Bots ke batšeakarolo ba phapoši ya maemo a pele. E nngwe le e nngwe e na le senotlelo sa Ed25519 le leswao; molaetša o mongwe le o mongwe wo ba o romelago o saennwe, ka gona bofora bo a lemogwa.
bots.h1_b: Theha: mong'a POSTs ` / api / bots` le ` {lebitso la mosebedisi, pontšo_lebitso, khoutu}`. Node e hlola mola wa `badiriši` ka `is_bot = therešo`, e tšweletša para ya dinotlelo ya Ed25519, e bušetša leswao la bot la senotlelo sa poraebete go mong (le bontšhitšwe gatee). Matha: bot e ka ba phela ka-tshebetso e le coroutine kapa ka ntle polls ` / api / bots / {id} / updates` le letšoao lona. Melaetša go tšwa go di-bot e rwala folaga ya `from_bot: true` gomme e saennwe ka senotlelo sa poraebete sa bot.
bots.h1_c: Di-API tša Bot di ile tša thongwa ke Slack (2014) gomme tša hlwekišwa ke Telegram (2015). Vortex's twist: bot ditshaeno tlama melaetsa ho bot boitsebiso, kahoo node kotsing e ne e ke ke ea bopa "@bot o ile a re X". Thekgo ya bot ya Matrix e okeditše thepa ye ka 2021 ka ditshaeno tše di kopantšwego; Vortex e na le yona go tloga ka v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix ke polelo ye e itšego ya domain ya go ngwala di-bot tšeo di laolwago ke ditiragalo. E nyenyane, e bontšhago, e kgobokeditšwego go bytecode ya sandboxed.
bots.h2_b: Popegopolelo: `ka / thoma { emit "Dumela, {ctx.leina_la_pele}!" }`. Handlers tlama ho di hlohleletsago (taelo, regex, ketsahalo). Mmele ke tatelano ya `romela`, `a re`, `ge e ba`, `peelano`, bj.bj.. Mokgoboketši o ntšha bytecode; nako ya go sepela e hlatholla ka lepokisi la lehlabathe leo le se nago tshepedišo ya faele, ga go na netweke ya boithatelo, fela Vortex ya API. Tšhupetšo ka botlalo kgaolong ya Gravitix docs.
bots.h2_c: Gravitix e hlamilwe nakong ya v0.0.6 ka morago ga go hlokomela gore bontši bja khoutu ya bot e be e le 80 % ya boilerplate go wire godimo ga Vortex SDK, ka kernel ya logic ya nnete bogareng. A DSL e dumelela logic e phadima gomme e thibela go garafola Python ka boithatelo tikologong ya bot-dev moo go nago le kgonagalo ya gore go tšhaba ga lepokisi la santa.
bots.h3_a: Kamore e nngwe le e nngwe e na le bot ya antispam yeo e sa bonagalego yeo e lebelelago mafula, spam ya kgokagano, melaetša yeo e boeletšwago le go thuthupa ga go tsenela ga akhaonto ye mpsha.
bots.h3_b: Melawana: segokanyipalo sa kgokagano > 3 ka motsotso go tšwa go mosediriši o tee, ALL-CAPS karolelano > 70 % ka melaetša ≥ 10 chars, molaetša pheta > 3 makhetlo ka 30 s, phatloha ha joiners le akhaonto lilemo < 24 h > 20 ka 60 s. Ditiro di a oketšega: temošo → nako ya go fela ya metsotso ye 5 → Kick ya iri ye 1 → thibelo (tumelelo ya molaodi ya thibelo). Tuneable ka-kamore ka ` / antispam config`.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics e tšwa go tswako ya melao ya bot ya IRC-era (Eggdrop, BitchX) le ditshepedišo tša sebjalebjale tša go swana le Discord AutoMod. Meelo ye e itšego ka go Vortex e be e tuned kgahlanong le khophase ya beta ya dikgwedi tše 6 ya melaetša ya 200k; sekhahla sa maaka-positive ke ~ 0.3 % ka sekgahla sa thibelo-boipiletšo seo se hlokometšwego.
bots.h4_a: Di-bot tša setšhaba di ikokobeletša mmarakeng. Basekaseki ba netefatša gore ga go na phishing / ga go na spam / ga go na go dutla ga data. Badiriši ba phetla ka legoro gomme ba tsenya ka go klika ga tee.
bots.h4_b: Thomelo: mong wa poso bot mohlodi + tlhaloso. Mohlahlobi o sepetša khoutu ka lepokisi la mohlaba, o e bala bakeng sa dipaterone tše di tsebjago tša go lwantšha, o hlahloba megala efe goba efe ya netweke yeo e fetago ka di-API tše di dumeletšwego, o netefatša pholisi ya sephiri. Listing: sehlopha, theko, tekanyetso, kenya bala. Kenya: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` — node e bopa peeletšo ya mosebedisi ka e mong. Monetization: mahala / nako e le nngwe / peeletšo; sethaleng nka 10 %.
bots.h4_c: Mebaraka ya App e boela morago go App Store ya 2008. Slack App Directory (2015), Mananeo a Bot a Discord (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Vortex o 10 % sehiloeng ke tlaase ho feta Apple o 30 % le hanyenyane tlaase ho feta Shopify o 20 %, kgethile ho hlohlelletsa bahlahisi ho phatlalatsa. Pholisi ya tshekatsheko e swantšhwa ka "tshekatsheko ka go ikemela, tloša lenaneo ka ngongorego" ya GitLab.

ops.title: Ditiro tša go šoma
ops.subtitle: Deploy, hlokomela, rollback.
ops.intro: Mošomo wo mongwe le wo mongwe wa tshepedišo o na le nepišo ya `dira` goba taelo ya CLI. Matlakala a Ops a phela ka `go tsenya tirišong/`.
ops.h1p1: `docker hlama godimo` e tliša node, molaodi, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1p2: Dibolumo: ` / ya data / vortex.db `, ` / ya data / uploads `, ` / ya data / dilog`. Thaba go moamogedi bakeng sa go phegelela.
ops.h1p3: Tikologo: `.env` ka modu wa repo. Le ka mohla o se ke wa itlama. `.env.example` ke thempleite.
ops.h1p4: Caddy auto-lata Let's Encrypt certs. Let's Encrypt meeli sekhahla sebetsa - sebelisa staging bakeng sa liteko.
ops.h2p1: `etsa kenya` — kenya Python deps + dev disebediswa.
ops.h2p2: `etsa dev` - uvicorn le reload ka koung 9000.
ops.h2p4: `etsa lint` - ruff + mypy. CI diboloko ka go palelwa.
ops.h2p8: `etsa ci` — matha ka botlalo CI phaephe sebakeng seo.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` ke sehlopha sa PyInstaller se nang le pywebview GUI.
ops.h3p2: Phallo ya pele-matha: kgetha leina la node → tšweletša dinotlelo tša go lokollwa → beakanya TLS (Let's Encrypt / tliša-ya gago / go saennwe) → kgetha di-URL tša go tsena → kgontšha go utswa → bula dikou tša lebota la mollo.
ops.h3p3: Ka morago ga go hloma, wizate e dula e le khonsule ya molaodi: noutu ya go thoma/emisa, go lebelela dilog, dikološa dinotlelo, go oketša dithaka tše di kopantšwego.
ops.h4p1: Tokollo e nngwe le e nngwe e swailwe ka git. Tag e saennwe gape ka senotlelo sa go lokollwa ka fao tag ka boyona e a netefatšwa.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git checkout <tag> && etsa docker-haha && docker qapa ho fihlela -d`. Matha nodes drain le restart.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` tšehetsoa bakeng sa phetolelo e le 'ngoe e nyenyane morao. Go ya pele morago go nyaka tsenogare ya seatla.
ops.h1_a: `docker hlama godimo` e tliša mokgobo wa Vortex ka botlalo: node, molaodi, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-hlama.yml` ka modu wa repo. Dibolumo ` / ya data / vortex.db`, ​​` / ya data / uploads`, ` / ya data / dilogs` mounted ho moamoheli kahoo ya data phehella ho pholletsa le restarts. Healthchecks: node bophelo bo botle iff ` / bophelo bo botle / loketse` khutlela 200; molaodi iff ` / v1 / botšepehi` khutlela netefalitsoeng. Caddy auto-lata Let's Encrypt certs. `.env` phepelo diphiri (le ka mohla itlama). `.env.example` ke thempleite.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose ke mohlala wa de-facto bakeng sa ditshelo tse ngata intša hosted ditshebeletso. Umami, Sepoko, Plausible, Miniflux ka moka ba e šomiša. Faele ya go hlama ya Vortex e ile ya boeletšwa go tloga go v0.0.2 go ya pele; sebopego sa bjale se tsepame ka v0.0.5. Dilo tše dingwe (k8s, nomad) di tlogetšwe bjalo ka boitšhidullo bja bao ba šomago ka didirišwa tše kgolo.
ops.h2_a: Makefile ke entrypoint e bohareng bakeng sa mong le e mong dev le ops ketso. `dira thušo` e lokeletša diphetho.
ops.h2_b: `etsa kenya` → `pip kenya -r ditlhoko.txt`. `etsa dev` → uvicorn le reload. `etsa teko` → pytest + khupetso, dipholo tsa `khupetšo.xml`. `etsa lint` → ruff + mypy. `etsa docker-haha` → `docker haha ​​-t vortex: $ VERSION`. `etsa db-falla` → `alembic ntlafatso hlooho`. `etsa db-backup` / `etsa db-tsosolosa FILE=...`. `etsa ci` → feletseng CI phaephe sebakeng seo.
ops.h2_c: Makefile bjalo ka lefelo la go tsena la canonical ke mokgwa wa Unix wa mengwagasome, wo o amogetšwego ke projeke ye nngwe le ye nngwe ye kgolo ya Python (pytest, django, flask, fastapi). Didirišwa tše dingwe (Poetry, Hatch, uv) ke tatso ya ngwaga; Make e tena le bokahohleng.
ops.h3_a: Wizate ya go hloma ke sehlopha sa PyInstaller (`Vortex Wizard.app`) ka pywebview GUI yeo e sepelago ka opareitara ya lekga la mathomo ka go tsenywa tirišong.
ops.h3_b: Pele-matha phallo: khetha node lebitso → hlahisa lokolloa linotlolo (Ed25519 keypair bolokwa ho `keys / release.key`) → hlophisa TLS (Let's Encrypt / tlisa-ya hao / intša saennweng) → kgetha ho kena URLs (vortexx.sol / tloaelo domain name / .onion) → kgontsha boemo ba boiketlo → bula firewall likoung (di-iptables / ufw / pf). Ka morago ga go kitima la mathomo, wizate e dula bjalo ka khonsule ya molaodi: noutu ya go thoma/emisa, go lebelela dilog, go dikološa dinotlelo, go oketša dithaka tše di kopantšwego.
ops.h3_c: Diwizate tša go hloma ke mohlala wa didirišwa tšeo di itshwarelago tšeo di lebantšhitšego badiriši bao e sego ba sysadmin: Ghost's onboarding (2015), Standard Notes 'seva setup, Mastodon's installation questions. PyInstaller e re dumelela go romela binary e tee yeo e ka kgotlago gabedi; pywebview e tšweletša letlakala la HTML la selegae leo le hlankelwago ke molaodi wa FastAPI yo a kopantšwego API ka 127.0.0.1 — sephephediši UX ntle le go raragana ga go aga GUI ya setlogo.
ops.h4_a: Tokollo e nngwe le e nngwe e swailwe ka git. Rollback ke `git checkout <tag> && etsa docker-haha && docker qapa ho fihlela -d`. Dikhudugo di na le mešomo ya `downgrade ()`.
ops.h4_b: Dithegi di saennwe ka senotlelo sa go lokollwa ka fao tag ka boyona e a netefatšwa. Rollback tshebetso: checkout khale tag, rebuild setšoantšo, recreate ditshelo - matha dikgokelo drain ka SIGTERM (default 15 s mohau). DB: `alembic downgrade <rev>` e bušetša morago phetošo e tee. Go efoga tahlegelo ya data: ga re ke re lahlela dikholomo ka tokollong e tee; marotholi a direga N+1 ka morago ga gore khoutu e kgaotše go di bala.
ops.h4_c: Mohlala wa go huduga wa "khoutu-ke moka-khoutu" (go atološa-go huduga-konteraka) ke maemo a go tsenywa tirišong ga nako ya go se šome ya lefela. Tlhahlo ya go huduga ya Stripe (2019) e e hlaloša gabotse. Vortex o e amogetše ka morago ga tiragalo ya v0.0.3 moo go theoga ga kholomo go gapeleditšego lefasetere la tlhokomelo la metsotso ye 30.

mobile.title: Bareki ba sellathekeng
mobile.subtitle: iOS le Android - letsoalloa UI, prothokholo e tšoanang.
mobile.intro: Bobedi bareki ba diselefouno ke dithaka tše di tletšego, e sego diphuthelwana tše sesane tša wepe. Lebelela la setlogo, tshepedišo ya setlogo, dikopanyo tša setlogo (CallKit, ConnectionService, Lock Screen widgets).
mobile.h1p1: Sephuthelwana sa Swift ka go `ios/Dimojule/`. 30+ tšobotsi dimmojule, e mong le e SOLID-arola `api /` + `impl /` + `ui /`.
mobile.h1p2: Sepheo sa tirišo ka go `ios/VortexApp/`. XcodeGen spec ka ` ios / projeke.yml` tsosolosa xcodeproj.
mobile.h1p3: Crypto: CryptoKit (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id).
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Diphetogo ka moka tša leabela di feta ka `db.write`.
mobile.h1p6: Kgorometša: Di-APN ka `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Katološo ya Tirelo ya Tsebišo bakeng sa go hlatholla.
mobile.h2p1: Gradle porojeke e ne ka `android /`. 22 tšobotsi dimmojule le Hilt DI, tšoanang `api / impl / di / ui` arola.
mobile.h2p3: Crypto: Tšhireletšo ya AndroidX + Tink + ` argon2-jvm`.
mobile.h2p4: DB: Kamore e nang le FTS4 di hlohleletsago.
mobile.h3p1: Same 146-locale bundle le maina a setlogo (`Русский ru`, `Senyesemane en`, `中文 zh`, ...).
mobile.h3p2: Same 1500-emoji lethathamo le 9 dihlopha + letlalo-tones + MRU + batla.
mobile.h3p3: Same multi-akhaonto X25519 tlhohlo-karabelo bakeng sa switjha.
mobile.h3p4: Difoldara tša poledišano tše di swanago (Ka moka / Di bolokilwe / tlwaelo) ka go goga-le-go lahlela reordering.
mobile.h3p5: Same bolokwa-GIFs lenane (ha ho Tenor - botho pokello feela).
mobile.h3p6: Same kemiso-melaetsa UI, mabitso skrine, Premium boemo leqepheng la.
mobile.h1_a: iOS moreki ke Swift Package le 30 + tšobotsi dimmojule. Same HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC protocol e le moreki yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo mongwe.
mobile.h1_b: Dimojule tšeo di rulagantšwego ka tšobotsi: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Difaele`, `Di-call`, `Push`, `Emoji`, `Difoldara`, `Diakhaonto`, `SavedGifs`, `Dikgokagano`, `E rulagantšwego`, `Premium`, `Dikarabelo`, .... E mong le e arola ka `api / ` (diprothokhole), ` impl /` (dihlopha sekontiri), `ui /` (SwiftUI dipono). Crypto: CryptoKit bakeng sa X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift bakeng sa Argon2id. DB: GRDB ka FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFmošomo wa tlhamo. Kgorometša: Di-APN tšeo di nago le Katološo ya Tirelo ya Tsebišo bakeng sa go tswalelwa-go kgorometša go hlatholla.
mobile.h1_c: Diphuthelwana tša modular ke mokgwa wa maemo wa Swift go tloga ka Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). Karoganyo ya rena ka api/impl/ui ke SOLID-ish: go fetošwa ga go ithekga (dimmojule di ithekgile ka api/feela), karoganyo ya matshwenyego, testability (swap impl bakeng sa diteko). The 30 + modula bala ke kgetho bakeng sa haha ​​parallelism - mong le e mong modula compiles ka ho itšehla thajana.
mobile.h2_a: Android moreki liipone iOS: Kotlin + Hlama + Hilt DI. 22 tšobotsi dimmojule, tšoanang `api / impl / di` arola.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), nepišoSdk 34 (Android 14). Crypto: Tšhireletšo ya AndroidX + Tink bakeng sa AES-GCM; argon2-jvm bakeng sa Argon2id. DB: Kamore e nang le FTS4 di hlohleletsago. WebRTC: Mola WebRTC Android. Kgorometša: FCM ka FirebaseMessagingService + go tswalelwa enfelopo decryption. Gradle multi-mojule, Hilt amahanya tšobotsi dimmojule ntle le ho itšetleha ka ho toba.
mobile.h2_c: Compose ke Google o declarative UI toolkit, tsitsitseng ho tloha ka 2021. Hilt (2020) ke Google-endorsed DI tlhako ka holimo ho Dagger 2. Mmogo ba tšoana SwiftUI + thepa wrappers ka iOS bakeng sa ho haufi le-tšoanang mehaho ikutloa. Vortex e amogetše Compose/Hilt go tloga go v0.0.4 go ya pele; pejana Android e be e theilwe godimo ga View.
mobile.h3_a: Bobedi iOS le Android bundle e tšoanang 146-sebakeng seo JSON beha le mabitso a setlogo le 1500-emoji lethathamo — mosebedisi ngola 🥹 ka iOS 17 e etsa 🥹 ka Android 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios / Dimojule / Mehloli / I18N / Mehlodi / libakeng / *.json` liipone `android / app / src / ka sehloohong / matlotlo / sebakeng / *.json`. Bobedi ditiriso tse dingwe laela locale tokelo ya ka pele thakgolwa (polelo kgetha skrine) le phehella kgetho. Lethathamo la emoji ke JSON ya dihlopha tše 9 yeo e rometšwego ka diphuthelwana ka bobedi; e sidesteps OS-boemo emoji-set divergence e leng ka tsela e nngwe baka unrendered `?` glyphs ka OSes khale.
mobile.h3_c: Go romela lethathamo la gago la emoji ke mohlala wo Telegram a o šomišago (foroko ya bona ya Twemoji) le WhatsApp e dirišitšwego go fihla ka 2022. The trade-off: ~ 300 KB e oketšegilego ka tirišo bundle bakeng sa emoji + ~ 1.2 MB bakeng sa locales. Worth e bakeng sa sefapano-sethaleng ho lumellana.
